subtasks.description: Declare the 256×8 AES S-Box constant lookup table array with all 256 pre-computed substitution values. The table entries must be 8-bit wide as required by the module interface (S003).
constraints: The table must contain the exact standard AES S-Box substitution values for all 256 input bytes.
The declaration must be purely combinational; no registers or clock.

subtasks.description: Combinational assignment that continuously drives output b with the lookup table entry indexed by input a.
constraints: Purely combinational; no pipeline stages, enable signals, or registered outputs.
